rules.statement: A will creating a fidei commissum over the entire estate, with each child receiving an equal share, results in substitution of heirs upon the death of one child, allowing surviving children to inherit according to custom and without interruption.
rules.supporting_quote: "Their Lordships have had little difficulty in coming to the conclusion that according to the terms of the will the entire moiety settled upon the grandchildren is made the subject of one and the same fidei commissum. The request is not in the form of a disposition of one-third share of the whole to each of the institutes, but of a gift of the whole to the three institutes jointly, with benefit of survivorship and with substitution of their descendants."
